Class.name: IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.FTP.Adapter.RegexFTPInboundAdapter
Class.Description: Adapter that receives files via the FTP protocol.

UDLText.name: T
UDLText.Content: /* (may be overridden in BusinessService's OnInit() method by setting the properties ..Adapter.FilenameExpression,TimestampExpression,IsDirExpression,SizeExpression) */

Property.name: ServerListStyle
Property.Description:
Type of listing format returned by the FTP server.

'VMSAllVersions' means on VMS FTP servers, retrieve all versions listed, not only the latest VMS version of the file
This value is not pertinent if you select SFTP/SSH mode by using the value !SFTP for the SSHConfig setting.

UDLText.name: T
UDLText.Content: /* override from File superclass with new description (FTP not File) */

Property.name: DeleteFromServer
Property.Description:
Specifies whether or not to delete files from the FTP server after successful processing
If not deleted, the adapter will ignore files already processed until something else removes them from the FTP server.

Property.name: UseFileStream
Property.Description:
Should the adapter construct a FileStream or a GlobalStream for data received?
Note that regardless of this setting a FileStream will be used if ArchivePath or ArchiveIO is set.

UDLText.name: T
UDLText.Content: /* override from CommonSSH superclass with new description (no StayConnected time) */

Property.name: StayConnected
Property.Description: If zero, disconnect from the remote FTP server between attempts to retrieve a directory listing. A value of -1 means never disconnect.

UDLText.name: T
UDLText.Content: /* override from File superclass with new description (mention FTP server) */

Property.name: FilePath
Property.Description: Directory on the FTP server in which to effect FTP operations.

UDLText.name: T
UDLText.Content: /* override from File superclass with new description (mention FTP Binary vs. Ascii) and new InitialExpression */

Property.name: Charset
Property.Description:
FTP - Use the named Character encoding to translate characters from the file.
A * prepended to any of the charset names will cause a binary FTP transfer with the resulting data then translated using the specified encoding.
Note that Binary should be chosen for binary files and other cases when special characters such as line terminators must be preserved.
Other settings may be useful when transferring text documents via FTP.

Choices include:
Binary - binary transfer
Ascii - Ascii mode FTP transfer but no character encoding translation
Native - the default character encoding of the installed locale of the Ensemble server
latin1 - the ISO Latin1 8-bit encoding
ISO-8859-1 - the ISO Latin1 8-bit encoding
UTF-8 - the Unicode 8-bit encoding
Unicode - the Unicode 16-bit encoding (Little-Endian)
UnicodeBig - the Unicode 16-bit encoding (Big-Endian)
@<ttable> - <ttable> means a raw InterSystems character translation table name. A prefix of '@' means to use the named table.

UDLText.name: T
UDLText.Content: /* override from File superclass with new description (mention FTP server) */

Property.name: ArchivePath
Property.Description: Path on the Ensemble server to save a copy of each file received from the FTP server. If not given, the local copy of the file will be stored in a temporary location and then deleted after processing is completed. Note that the AppendTimestamp option must be used to avoid name collisions in the archive directory if the same filename will be retrieved repeatedly.

UDLText.name: T
UDLText.Content: /* override from File superclass with new description (omit mention of multiple wildcards) */

Property.name: FileSpec
Property.Description: Filename or wildcard file specification for file(s) to retrieve from the FTP server

Property.name: RegexFileSpec
Property.Description: Regex pattern to match the file names

UDLText.name: T
UDLText.Content: /* override from File superclass with new description (FTP related options) */

Property.name: ConfirmComplete
Property.Description:
Confirm complete receipt of file if possible, in case it is not completely available on the server at the time downloading begins.

'None' offers the fastest performance for small files because no extra FTP directory listing needs to be retrieved for each file download attempt

'Size' means keep reading more data for a file until the file size reported by the server directory listing does not increase
This option is only reliable for Charset='binary' transfers (In text mode the file position used for downloading may get corrupted by the insertion or removal of Linefeed characters)
This option alone may not be sufficient if the FTP server or source application is sluggish. If the server reports the same
size for the file 2 times in a row, 2 seconds apart, then Ensemble will consider the download complete. Therefore the 'Size & Rename' setting is preferable if the server supports 'Rename'.
This option relies on correct results from the Adapter.SizeExpression string set in the OnInit() method of the Business Service.

'Rename' means keep trying to read more data for a file until the server allows us to rename it
This option will only work if the FTP server grants Rename privilege to Ensemble for the download directory, using the Credentials
configured on this adapter, and if the file permissions on the file itself are set so that the FTP server has privilege to rename it.
If not then the Rename attempt will always fail and the Ensemble download will never complete

UDLText.name: T
UDLText.Content: /* override from File superclass with new description (omit mention of WorkPath) */

Property.name: AppendTimestamp
Property.Description: Append a timestamp to Archive filenames in order to prevent possible name collisions on repeated processing of the same filename.<p/> If this value is empty or 0, no timestamp will be appended. If it is 1, then the standard timestamped filename specification template '%f_%Q' will be used.<p/> Any other value will be used directly as a timestamped filename specification template.

Property.name: FilenameExpression
Property.Description: Expression for extracting the filename portion of a line of the FTP directory listing (%line)

Property.name: TimestampExpression
Property.Description: Expression for extracting the timestamp portion of a line of the FTP directory listing (%line)

Property.name: IsDirExpression
Property.Description: Expression for extracting the is-a-directory flag from the FTP directory listing (%line)

Property.name: SizeExpression
Property.Description: Expression for extracting the file size from the FTP directory listing (%line); if present used for detecting download complete status

Property.name: %NextLine
Property.Description: Lookahead buffer for VMS. Contains the next line in the input stream.

Property.name: %PrevSize
Property.Description: Previous file Size string for AS/400

Property.name: %PrevMod
Property.Description: Previous file Modified string for AS/400

Property.name: %PrevFile
Property.Description: Previous file Name string for AS/400

Property.name: %LastErr
Property.Description: Previous error if failed to get member FILENAME.FILENAME (forget it if we find any members)

Property.name: %LastFileNeedsRetrying
Property.Description: Record that the last file looked at in OnTask encountered a network error or needs retrying.
